answer.rationale: Avoid promotional pricing: the recovered discount experiment lifted acquisition but reduced 30-day retention by 12%, conflicting with sustainable qualified-revenue goals. Use in-product activation messaging to reinforce realized value for SMB accounts under price pressure; it has demonstrated improvement in week-one engagement and first meaningful action. Its direct effect on price-driven churn is unproven, so keep the response guarded rather than treating it as a confirmed retention solution.
